title: mcp: the server states its authoring contract version, refuses a client on a different major, and serves the restriction profile
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this seat's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「三点都同意，按最终计划把后续里程碑的卡全部立出来」, and, on the list of thirteen cards the seat then showed: 「同意」. The ruling records are #34659 comment 6940528935 and #34691 comment 6943107981. Readings: objectstack `a0326b06`, cloud `53a5844`, 2026-11-17.

## Why

When the knowledge lives on the client, the one new way to fail is a client that learned a different version of the rules than the server enforces.

Who acts: the server lane (`packages/mcp`, `packages/metadata-protocol`, `packages/runtime`). Reader: every client that builds.

## Evidence

- `initialize` reports `serverInfo.version`; nothing the open server sends says which `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/skills` to install.
- `RestrictionProfileSchema.versions { spec, skills }` exists (`packages/spec/src/system/restriction-profile.zod.ts:230-255`) and the CLI reads `GET /api/v1/discovery/restriction-profile` (`packages/cli/src/utils/restriction-profile.ts:139`); no open runtime package serves that route.
- Claude Code reads the first 4,096 characters of a server's instructions; anything after is cut.

## Scope

- `initialize` instructions and discovery state `Authoring contract: @objectstack/spec <version>`.
- `save_metadata_draft` takes an optional `clientSpecVersion`: a different major is refused with the install line; a different minor is advised (D4 = A). Validation of the stored item stays the final gate.
- The open runtime serves the restriction profile at the route the CLI already reads.
- The whole instructions text stays under 4,096 characters, the words a client routes on first.

## Done when

- A client declaring the previous major is refused with the command to run; `os validate --target` against a self-hosted runtime reads a profile instead of failing.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Ruling: D4 = A.
- Blocked-by: #34766
- Dedup, open and closed: `restriction-profile discovery route` none.
